notice: Hand-curated published scalars for the 2024 Red Sea crisis at the Port of Singapore. Every anchor is RECORDED: copied unchanged from the named publication on the named date. This file is the human-editable source of truth; scripts/build_crisis_fixture.py reads it and emits fixtures/crisis_ground_truth.json.

anchors.label: Peak berthing delay at Singapore, late May 2024
anchors.source: Linerlytica, 'Singapore port congestion reach critical levels'
anchors.quote: Berthing delays at the world's second largest container port of up to 7 days.

anchors.label: Container capacity waiting to berth at the peak
anchors.source: Linerlytica, 'Singapore port congestion reach critical levels'
anchors.quote: the total capacity waiting to berth rising to 450,000 teu in recent days

anchors.label: Average wait time at the port after mitigation
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: As a result, the average wait time at the port in recent weeks has been reduced to two days or less.

anchors.label: Vessel port stays at PSA versus the same period in 2023
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: In addition, vessel port stays at PSA have also increased by 22% compared to the same period last year.

anchors.label: Container re-handlings on mega vessels, H1 2024 versus H1 2023
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: Container re-handlings on mega vessels berthed at PSA have increased by 8% in the first half of 2024, compared to the previous year.

anchors.label: Container vessels arriving off-schedule at Singapore, 2024
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: Singapore's port has seen about 90% of container vessels arriving off-schedule, compared to an average of about 77% in 2023.

anchors.label: Container vessels arriving off-schedule at Singapore, 2023 average
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: Singapore's port has seen about 90% of container vessels arriving off-schedule, compared to an average of about 77% in 2023.

anchors.label: PSA container volumes, H1 2024 versus H1 2023
anchors.source: PSA International news release, 'PSA Group and Singapore mitigate impact of global supply chain disruptions'
anchors.quote: PSA moved 7% more container volumes in the first half of 2024, compared to the same period last year. This is a PSA Group figure, not a Singapore-only figure.

throughput_2023_teu.source: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore media release
throughput_2023_teu.quote: Singapore's container throughput in 2023 grew by 4.6% reaching a new high of 39.01 million twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs).
throughput_2023_teu.used_for: Calibrating the synthesised per-call TEU distribution in scripts/build_crisis_fixture.py.

charter_rate_usd_per_day.basis: Round proxy for the daily cost of a waiting mid-size container ship, used only to express wait-days in money. Mid-2024 fixtures in the 4,000-6,000 TEU band were reported around USD 28,000-30,000 per day: the 5,060 TEU Heng Hui 6 at USD 28,000/day and the 4,636 TEU Zhong Gu Shen Yang at USD 30,000/day.
charter_rate_usd_per_day.source: Container News, 'International box lines fix Chinese domestic vessels as charter market soars'
